```{r}
# load data
datapath <- 'data/'
DataFiles <- list.files(path = datapath, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

df_raw_all <- data.frame()

for (k in 1:length(DataFiles)) {
  df_temp <- read_csv(
    DataFiles[k],
    col_types = cols(
      rt = col_double(),
      response = col_character(),
      correct_response = col_character(),
      correct = col_logical(),
      block_failed = col_logical(),
      blocks_failed_total = col_double(),
      .default = col_guess()
    ),
    na = c("", "NA", "null", "NaN")
  )
  
  # Extract subject ID from filename
  subj_id <- str_match(basename(DataFiles[k]), "Han_curvRep1D_(\\d+)_")[, 2]
  df_temp$subj_id <- subj_id
  
  df_raw_all <- bind_rows(df_raw_all, df_temp)
}

df_raw_all <- df_raw_all %>% 
  select(subj_id, total_experiment_time, age, sex, art_experience, strategy_open, rt, stimulus, response, block, block_index, trial_in_block, global_trial_index, trial_kind, pattern, feature_ids, features_triplet, stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right, is_practice, is_catch, correct_response, correct, chosen_index, chosen_stimulus, chosen_nv, chosen_ang, chosen_s, chosen_rot, chosen_curv)

```

```{r}
# catch trial accuracy for main trials
# main_catch <- df_raw_all %>%
#   filter(trial_kind == "catch")
# 
# main_catch %>%
#   group_by(participant) %>%
#   summarise(
#     n_catch = n(),
#     n_correct = sum(correct == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
#     accuracy = mean(correct == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))

# each participant must get 75% catch trial accuracy min in each block to pass that block
block_catch_summary <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(trial_kind == "catch") %>%
  group_by(subj_id, block_index) %>%
  summarise(
    n_catch = n(),
    n_correct = sum(correct == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    acc = n_correct / n_catch,
    blockUse = if_else(acc >= 0.75, 1, 0),  # 1 if acc >= 75%, else 0
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count failed blocks per participant and assign subUse flag
subject_quality <- block_catch_summary %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_failed_blocks = sum(blockUse == 0),  # Count blocks where blockUse = 0
    subUse = if_else(n_failed_blocks > 3, 0, 1),  # Flag: 0 if >3 failed, else 1
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View results
subject_quality
subject_quality %>%
  count(subUse)

# Add subUse flag to original data frame
df_raw_all <- df_raw_all %>%
  left_join(subject_quality %>% select(subj_id, subUse), 
            by = "subj_id") %>%
  left_join(block_catch_summary %>% select(subj_id, block_index, blockUse),
            by = c("subj_id", "block_index"))

```

```{r}
# Calculate total percentage of trials excluded
exclusion_summary <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(subUse == 1,  # Only subjects with subUse = 1
         trial_kind %in% c('exp_111', 'exp_221')) %>%  # Only these trial types
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_trials = n(),  # Total trials before exclusion
    excluded_trials = sum(blockUse == 0 | rt < 500, na.rm = TRUE),  # Excluded trials
    included_trials = sum(blockUse == 1 & rt >= 500, na.rm = TRUE),  # Included trials
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate overall exclusion percentage
overall_exclusion <- exclusion_summary %>%
  summarise(
    total_trials_all = sum(total_trials),
    total_excluded = sum(excluded_trials),
    total_included = sum(included_trials),
    exclusion_pct = (total_excluded / total_trials_all) * 100
  )

# View results
overall_exclusion
```

```{r}
# each row = one item in the triad. 
df_items <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  mutate(triad_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    subj_id, triad_id, chosen_index,
    stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right),
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "stim_path"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_index = case_when(
      position == "stim_left"   ~ 0L,
      position == "stim_middle" ~ 1L,
      position == "stim_right"  ~ 2L
    ),
    choice = as.integer(pos_index == chosen_index),
    is_chosen = pos_index == chosen_index,
    nv   = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "stim_nv(\\d+)_")[,2]),
    ang  = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "ang(\\d+)_s")[,2]),
    sm_s = as.numeric(str_match(stim_path, "s([0-9.]+)_rot")[,2]),
    sm = case_when(
      sm_s == 0.0 ~ 0,
      sm_s == 0.8 ~ 1,
      sm_s == 1.4 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_  # Handle unexpected values
    )
  )

head(df_items)
```


##### Multinomial Logistic #####

```{r}

# Logit optimization asks:
#   “What weights best predict which item wins the competition in each triad?”
#   "what feature helps me pick the odd item?"
# This favors:
#   features that are diagnostic in competitive contexts
#   features that dominate when they differ
#   even if they don’t structure overall similarity well

# RDM optimization asks:
#   “What weights best preserve all pairwise similarities across all contexts?”
#   "what does the perceptual space look like?"
# This favors:
#   globally consistent dimensions
#   dimensions that structure the whole space
#   even if they don’t always determine the odd-one-out
# 


```

```{r}
# Alternative-Specific (Long) Format
# one row per alternative (item) per choice set (triad)
# the choice depends on which item is most different, not the absolute attribute 
# values. By centering on the triad mean, we are explicitly modeling "how odd is this 
# item?"

alt_data_diff <- df_items %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  mutate(   # deviation from the triad mean
    sm_dev = abs(sm_s - mean(sm_s)),
    nv_dev   = abs(nv - mean(nv)),
    ang_dev  = abs(ang - mean(ang))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(trial_id = paste0(subj_id, "_", triad_id)) %>%
  mutate(   # standardizes by the max deviation (makes attributes relative/comparative)
    sm_dev_s = sm_dev / max(sm_dev),
    nv_dev_s   = nv_dev   / max(nv_dev),
    ang_dev_s  = ang_dev  / max(ang_dev)
  ) %>%
  select(subj_id, trial_id, pos_index, choice, 
         sm_dev_s, nv_dev_s, ang_dev_s)


# Convert to mlogit format
mlogit_data <- mlogit.data(
  data = alt_data_diff,
  shape = "long",
  choice = "choice",
  chid.var = "trial_id",
  alt.var = "pos_index",
  id.var = "subj_id"
)

# Fit multinomial logit model
# coefficient signs positive = more likely to choose (larger deviation = more "odd")
# No individual-specific variables with alternative-specific effects
# No individual-specific variables with generic effects
model_m <- gmnl(
  choice ~ sm_dev_s + nv_dev_s + ang_dev_s | 0 | 0 | 0,
  data = mlogit_data,
  model = "mixl",
  ranp = c(            # random slopes for each attribute across subjects
    sm_dev_s = "n",
    nv_dev_s   = "n",
    ang_dev_s  = "n"
  ),
  panel = TRUE
)

summary(model_m)
# Fixed Effects (Mean Coefficients)
# Random Effects (Standard Deviations)

# Extract normalized weights
beta_hat <- coef(model_m)
beta_mean <- beta_hat[c("sm_dev_s", "nv_dev_s", "ang_dev_s")]

weights_mnl <- abs(beta_mean) / sum(abs(beta_mean))
weights_mnl

```
```{r}
# --- GLOBAL SETTINGS ---
# Define consistent levels and colors for all plots
feat_levels <- c("Smoothness", "NV", "Angle")

# 1. Extract Fixed Effects (Mean Coefficients)
# We filter for the mean parameters, ignoring the 'sd.' parameters
beta_est <- coef(model_m)[c("sm_dev_s", "nv_dev_s", "ang_dev_s")]
beta_se  <- sqrt(diag(vcov(model_m)))[c("sm_dev_s", "nv_dev_s", "ang_dev_s")]

df_fixed <- data.frame(
  Feature = names(beta_est),
  Estimate = as.numeric(beta_est),
  SE = as.numeric(beta_se)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * SE,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * SE,
    # Clean names for plotting
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = c("sm_dev_s", "nv_dev_s", "ang_dev_s"),
                     labels = feat_levels)
  )

# Plot: Mean Effects
ggplot(df_fixed, aes(x = Feature, y = Estimate, fill = Feature)) +
  # Bar plot
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black") + 
  # Error bars (95% CI)
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Classic theme (removes grid lines and background)
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Population Mean Sensitivity",
    subtitle = "Higher estimates = stronger preference for the deviant item",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log-Odds Estimate (Mean Beta)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, max(df_fixed$Upper) * 1.1))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 2. Extract Individual Conditional Means (Corrected)
features_raw <- c("sm_dev_s", "nv_dev_s", "ang_dev_s")

df_indiv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:3, function(i) {
  eff <- effect.gmnl(model_m, par = features_raw[i], effect = "ce")
  
  # create data frame without relying on row names
  data.frame(
    Value = as.numeric(eff$mean),  # Flattens the matrix/vector
    Feature = feat_levels[i]
  )
}))

df_indiv$Feature <- factor(df_indiv$Feature, levels = feat_levels)

# Plot: Density Distributions of Subject Strategies
ggplot(df_indiv, aes(x = Value, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Feature, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Heterogeneity in Strategy",
    subtitle = "Distribution of individual subject coefficients",
    x = "Individual Sensitivity (Beta)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# 3. Predicted Probability Curve (Marginal Effect)
# Function to calculate Logit Probability for a standardized deviation x (0 to 1)
# Assumes a 3-choice task where other 2 items have 0 deviation (baseline)
predict_prob <- function(beta, x_vals) {
  # Utility of target = beta * x
  # Utility of distractors = beta * 0 = 0
  # Prob = exp(u_target) / (exp(u_target) + exp(0) + exp(0))
  exp(beta * x_vals) / (exp(beta * x_vals) + 1 + 1)
}

# Create a sequence of deviations from 0 to 1
x_seq <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)

# Generate curves for the Mean Observer
df_pred <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:3) {
  probs <- predict_prob(beta_est[i], x_seq)
  df_pred <- rbind(df_pred, data.frame(
    Deviation = x_seq,
    Probability = probs,
    Feature = feat_levels[i]
  ))
}
df_pred$Feature <- factor(df_pred$Feature, levels = feat_levels)

# Plot: Sensitivity Curves
ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = Deviation, y = Probability, color = Feature)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1/3, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.3, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Behavioral Sensitivity (Mean Observer)",
    x = "Standardized Deviation (0 = Mean, 1 = Max)",
    y = "Probability of Choosing Item"
  )

```

```{r}
#Using MNL weights for clustering
library(cluster)   # for silhouette
library(factoextra) # for cluster visualization
# =========================
# 1. Fit per-subject MNL to get weights
# =========================

# Extract subject IDs
subj_ids <- unique(alt_data_diff$subj_id)

# Function to compute empirical odds per subject
subject_weights <- lapply(subj_ids, function(s) {
  dat_subj <- alt_data_diff %>% filter(subj_id == s)
  
  # Fit multinomial logit for this subject only
  m_subj <- mlogit(choice ~ sm_dev_s + nv_dev_s + ang_dev_s | 0,
                   data = mlogit.data(dat_subj, shape="long", choice="choice",
                                      chid.var="trial_id", alt.var="pos_index"))
  beta <- coef(m_subj)
  tibble(
    subj_id = s,
    sm   = beta["sm_dev_s"],
    nv     = beta["nv_dev_s"],
    ang    = beta["ang_dev_s"]
  )
})

weights_df <- bind_rows(subject_weights)

# Normalize weights per subject
weights_df <- weights_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(abs(c(sm, nv, ang))),
    sm = sm / total,
    nv   = nv   / total,
    ang  = ang  / total
  ) %>%
  select(-total)

# =========================
# 2. Choosing the optimal number of clusters
# =========================
# Convert to matrix
weight_mat <- as.matrix(weights_df %>% select(sm, nv, ang))

set.seed(4228)

# Elbow method
fviz_nbclust(weight_mat, kmeans, method = "wss") +
  labs(subtitle = "Elbow method")

# Silhouette method
fviz_nbclust(weight_mat, kmeans, method = "silhouette") +
  labs(subtitle = "Average silhouette method") # higher = better clustering



#prettier plots 
# =========================
# 3. ELBOW plot
# =========================

max_k <- 8
wss <- numeric(max_k)

for (k in 1:max_k) {
  km <- kmeans(weight_mat, centers = k, nstart = 50)
  wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(
  1:max_k, wss,
  type = "b", pch = 19,
  xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
  ylab = "Total within-cluster SS",
  main = "Elbow Method for Optimal k"
)

# =========================
# 4. SILHOUETTE plot
# =========================
pp_dist <- dist(weight_mat)
sil_width <- rep(NA_real_, max_k)

for (k in 2:max_k) {
  km <- kmeans(weight_mat, centers = k, nstart = 50)
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(weight_mat))
  sil_width[k] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}

plot(
  2:max_k, sil_width[2:max_k],
  type = "b", pch = 19,
  xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
  ylab = "Mean silhouette width",
  main = "Silhouette Method for Optimal k"
)

abline(v = which.max(sil_width), lty = 2, col = "red")
```


```{r}
# =========================
# 3. Fit k-means with chosen k
# =========================
k_opt <- 2  # replace with chosen number based on elbow/silhouette plots
kres <- kmeans(weight_mat, centers = k_opt, nstart = 50)
weights_df$cluster <- kres$cluster

cluster_sizes <- table(weights_df$cluster)
# Order clusters, largest first
cluster_order <- names(sort(cluster_sizes, decreasing = TRUE))
# Re-map largest to Cluster 1
weights_df$cluster <- as.numeric(factor(weights_df$cluster, levels = cluster_order))

# =========================
# 4. Visualize clusters
# =========================
fviz_cluster(kres, data = weight_mat, geom = "point", stand = FALSE,
             ellipse.type = "convex") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("K-means Clustering of Subject Weights (k =", k_opt, ")"))

cluster_means <- weights_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sm = mean(sm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_nv   = mean(nv, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ang  = mean(ang, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_subjects = n()
  )
cluster_means

######################
# bar plot 
summary_df <- weights_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sm = mean(sm, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_sm   = sd(sm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    mean_nv = mean(nv, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_nv   = sd(nv, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    mean_ang = mean(ang, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_ang   = sd(ang, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    n = n()
  )

plot_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_to = "attribute",
    values_to = "mean_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    se = case_when(
      attribute == "mean_sm" ~ se_sm,
      attribute == "mean_nv" ~ se_nv,
      attribute == "mean_ang" ~ se_ang
    ),
    attribute = gsub("mean_", "", attribute),
    attribute = factor(attribute, levels = c("sm", "nv", "ang"))
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(cluster), y = mean_value, fill = attribute)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
           color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.2,
    size = 0.6
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Mean Weights per Cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Mean Normalized β",
    fill = "Attribute"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 0.6))


# =========================
# 5. Silhouette score
# =========================
dist_mat <- dist(weight_mat, method = "euclidean")
sil <- silhouette(weights_df$cluster, dist_mat)
mean(sil[, 3])  # average silhouette width
```

##### Behavioral Representational Dissimilarity Matrix (RDM) #####
```{r}
# OVERVIEW: Constructs subject-wise and averaged behavioral RDMs from triad choice data.
# - Data: Subjects choose 1 of 3 stimuli per triad (27 unique stimuli).
# - Dissimilarity D for pair (i,j): P(pair split as chosen-non_chosen | co-occur in triad).
# - High D = often discriminated = behaviorally dissimilar.

```

```{r}
items_short <- df_items %>%
  select(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index, is_chosen, sm, nv, ang)

pairs <- df_items %>%
  select(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index, is_chosen, sm, nv, ang) %>%
  inner_join(items_short, by = c("subj_id", "triad_id"), suffix = c("_i", "_j")) %>%
  filter(pos_index_i < pos_index_j) %>%
  arrange(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index_i, pos_index_j) %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  mutate(
    pair_in_triad = row_number(),
    trial_id = cur_group_id() 
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    subj_id,
    triad_id,
    pair_in_triad,
    sm_i = sm_i, nv_i = nv_i, ang_i = ang_i,
    sm_j = sm_j, nv_j = nv_j, ang_j = ang_j,
    chosen_i = is_chosen_i,
    chosen_j = is_chosen_j,
    same_sm  = as.integer(sm_i == sm_j),
    same_vert  = as.integer(nv_i   == nv_j),
    same_angle = as.integer(ang_i  == ang_j),
    co_group   = as.integer(!chosen_i & !chosen_j),
    diff_sm  = as.factor(abs(sm_i - sm_j)),
    diff_nv    = as.factor(abs(nv_i   - nv_j)),
    diff_ang   = as.factor(abs(ang_i  - ang_j)),
    trial_id
  )


```




```{r}
# Step 1: Prep data and extract chosen-non_chosen pairs
stim_lookup <- df_items %>%
  select(sm, nv, ang) %>%
  distinct(sm, nv, ang) %>%
  arrange(sm, nv, ang) %>%
  mutate(stim_id = row_number())

stopifnot(nrow(stim_lookup) == 27)

triad_long <- df_items %>%
  select(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index, is_chosen, sm, nv, ang) %>%
  left_join(stim_lookup, by = c("sm", "nv", "ang")) %>%
  rename(stim_id = stim_id)

pairs_chosen_nc <- triad_long %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  filter(n() == 3) %>%  # Sanity: exactly 3 stimuli/triad
  mutate(chosen_flag = is_chosen == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    chosen_id = stim_id[chosen_flag],
    non_ids = list(stim_id[!chosen_flag]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(non_ids, values_to = "non_id") %>%
  mutate(
    low  = pmin(chosen_id, non_id),   # Unordered pair for aggregation
    high = pmax(chosen_id, non_id)
  )
# Output: One row per subj-triple-chosen_non pair (2 per triplet).

```

```{r}
# Step 2: Compute per-subject D
pairs_id <- df_items %>%
  select(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index, is_chosen, sm, nv, ang) %>%
  inner_join(., ., by = c("subj_id", "triad_id"), suffix = c("_i", "_j")) %>%
  filter(pos_index_i < pos_index_j) %>%
  left_join(stim_lookup, by = c("sm_i" = "sm", "nv_i" = "nv", "ang_i" = "ang")) %>%
  rename(stim_id_i = stim_id) %>%
  left_join(stim_lookup, by = c("sm_j" = "sm", "nv_j" = "nv", "ang_j" = "ang")) %>%
  rename(stim_id_j = stim_id) %>%
  mutate(
    low  = pmin(stim_id_i, stim_id_j),
    high = pmax(stim_id_i, stim_id_j)
  )

D_subj <- pairs_id %>%
  # Mark chosen-nonchosen relations (analogous to co_group for similarity)
  mutate(chosen_nc = (is_chosen_i == 1 & is_chosen_j == 0) | 
                    (is_chosen_j == 1 & is_chosen_i == 0)) %>%
  group_by(subj_id, low, high) %>%
  summarise(
    n_appear    = n(),           # Total appearances (denominator)
    n_chosen_nc = sum(chosen_nc), # # chosen-nonchosen (numerator, analog n_win)
    D           = n_chosen_nc / n_appear,  # P(chosen-non | co-occur)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(D))


```

```{r}
# Step 3: Average across subjects
D_avg <- D_subj %>%
  group_by(low, high) %>%
  summarise(
    D_mean = mean(D, na.rm = TRUE),
    D_sd   = sd(D, na.rm = TRUE),
    D_se   = D_sd / sqrt(n()),
    n_subj = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Output: Group-level dissimilarities with stats.

# Step 4: Build symmetric RDM matrix
n_stim <- nrow(stim_lookup)  # 27
D_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_stim, ncol = n_stim)  # NA for unseen pairs
rownames(D_mat) <- colnames(D_mat) <- stim_lookup$stim_id

# Fill off-diagonals (loop matches your old exact style)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(D_avg))) {
  i <- D_avg$low[k]
  j <- D_avg$high[k]
  D_mat[i, j] <- D_avg$D_mean[k]
  D_mat[j, i] <- D_avg$D_mean[k]
}

diag(D_mat) <- 0  # Explicit (overwrites any diag NAs)
```

```{r}
matrix_to_long <- function(M) {
  as_tibble(M, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
    mutate(id_i = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-id_i, names_to = "id_j", values_to = "val") %>%
    mutate(
      id_i = as.integer(id_i),
      id_j = as.integer(id_j)
    )
}

plot_long <- bind_rows(
  matrix_to_long(D_mat) %>% mutate(metric = "Dissimilarity")
)

sm_blocks <- tibble(
  sm  = 0:2,
  start = c(1, 10, 19),
  end   = c(9, 18, 27),
  mid   = c(5, 14, 23),
  label = paste0("sm", 0:2)
)

nv_blocks <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sm = 0:2,
  nv   = 1:3
) %>%
  mutate(
    start = sm*9 + (nv-1)*3 + 1,
    end   = start + 2,
    mid   = (start + end)/2,
    nv    = paste0("n", nv)
  )

plot_matrix <- function(
  M, stim_lookup,
  value_name = "Similarity",
  title = "",
  limits = c(0,1),
  palette = "plasma",
  na_value = "grey90",
  legend_title_size = 9,
  show_sm_labels = TRUE,
  show_nv_labels   = TRUE,
  show_ang_right   = TRUE,
  base_size = 14
) {

  stopifnot(is.matrix(M))
  stopifnot(all(c("sm","nv","ang","stim_id") %in% names(stim_lookup)))

  stim_order <- stim_lookup %>% arrange(sm, nv, ang) %>% pull(stim_id)
  N <- length(stim_order)

  M_long <- matrix_to_long(M) %>%
    mutate(
      id_i = factor(id_i, levels = stim_order),
      id_j = factor(id_j, levels = stim_order)
    )

  ang_right <- stim_lookup %>%
    arrange(sm, nv, ang) %>%
    transmute(y = stim_id, label = paste0("a", ang))

  p <- ggplot(M_long, aes(id_i, id_j, fill = val)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = palette,
      direction = -1,
      limits = limits,
      name = value_name,
      na.value = na_value
    ) +
    coord_equal(clip = "off", xlim = c(.5, N+.5), ylim = c(.5, N+.5)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 130, 70, 90)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title)

  sm_cuts <- seq(9.5, 18.5, by = 9)
  nv_cuts   <- sort(c(sm_cuts - 6, sm_cuts - 3, sm_cuts + 3, sm_cuts + 6))
  ang_cuts  <- setdiff(seq(1.5, 26.5, by = 1), c(sm_cuts, nv_cuts))

  add_lines <- function(p, xs, lw, a = 1)
    Reduce(`+`, lapply(xs, \(x)
      list(
        geom_vline(xintercept = x, linewidth = lw, alpha = a),
        geom_hline(yintercept = x, linewidth = lw, alpha = a)
      )
    ), init = p)

  p <- p |>
    add_lines(sm_cuts, 0.9) |>
    add_lines(nv_cuts,   0.45, 0.9) |>
    add_lines(ang_cuts,  0.22, 0.55)

  if (show_ang_right)
    p <- p + geom_text(data = ang_right,
                       aes(x = N + 1.2, y = y, label = label),
                       inherit.aes = FALSE,
                       hjust = 0, size = 3)
  if (show_sm_labels)
  p <- p + geom_text(
    data = sm_blocks,
    aes(x = mid, y = 0, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.6,
    size = 3
  )
  
  if (show_nv_labels)
  p <- p + geom_text(
    data = nv_blocks,
    aes(x = 0, y = mid, label = nv),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.4,
    size = 3,
  )


  p
}
```

```{r}
# Correlation between ideal matrices and empirical matrix. 

get_rdm_vec <- function(M) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(M))
  M[upper.tri(M, diag = FALSE)]
}

rdm_cor_stats <- function(emp, model, method = "pearson", conf.level = 0.95) {
  v_emp   <- get_rdm_vec(emp)
  v_model <- get_rdm_vec(model)

  ok <- !is.na(v_emp) & !is.na(v_model)

  ct <- cor.test(
    v_emp[ok],
    v_model[ok],
    method = method,
    conf.level = conf.level
  )

  tibble(
    estimate   = unname(ct$estimate),          # r or rho
    statistic = unname(ct$statistic),          # t or S
    df        = unname(ct$parameter),           # df (Pearson only)
    p_value   = ct$p.value,
    ci_low    = ct$conf.int[1],
    ci_high   = ct$conf.int[2],
    n         = sum(ok),
    method    = method
  )
}


rdm_results <- bind_rows(
  sm = bind_rows(
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_sm, "pearson"),
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_sm, "spearman")
  ),
  nv = bind_rows(
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_nv, "pearson"),
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_nv, "spearman")
  ),
  ang = bind_rows(
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_ang, "pearson"),
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_ang, "spearman")
  ),
  additive = bind_rows(
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_add01, "pearson"),
    rdm_cor_stats(D_mat, ideal_add01, "spearman")
  ),
  .id = "model"
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# K-means clustering of participants
# -------------------------

# Compute participant-specific RDMs
n_items <- 27

participant_rdms <- D_subj %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    RDM = list({
      # Initialize dissimilarity matrix (matches your D_mat style)
      D_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_items, ncol = n_items)
      rownames(D_mat) <- colnames(D_mat) <- as.character(1:n_items)
      
      # Fill D matrix with subject-specific ratios
      for (k in seq_len(n())) {
        i <- low[k]
        j <- high[k]
        D_mat[i, j] <- D[k]  # <-- D from D_subj (~2 for observed)
        D_mat[j, i] <- D[k]
      }
      diag(D_mat) <- 0
      D_mat  
    }),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# We only use the upper triangle (off-diagonal) to avoid redundancy
get_upper_vec <- function(mat) mat[upper.tri(mat)]
participant_rdms_vec <- participant_rdms %>%
  mutate(RDM_vec = map(RDM, get_upper_vec))

subj_ids <- participant_rdms$subj_id
n_subj <- length(subj_ids)
```

```{r}
# Mean Spearman correlation between a cluster’s participant RDMs and a feature model RDM

make_feature_rdm <- function(feature) {
  v <- stim_lookup[[feature]]
  as.matrix(dist(v))
}

RDM_sm <- make_feature_rdm("sm")
RDM_nv   <- make_feature_rdm("nv")
RDM_ang  <- make_feature_rdm("ang")

get_vec <- function(mat) mat[upper.tri(mat)]

model_vecs <- tibble(
  feature = c("sm", "nv", "ang"),
  vec = list(
    get_vec(RDM_sm),
    get_vec(RDM_nv),
    get_vec(RDM_ang)
  )
)


participant_rsa_weights <- participant_rdms %>%
  mutate(RDM_vec = map(RDM, ~ .x[upper.tri(.x)])) %>%
  crossing(model_vecs) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = map2_dbl(
      RDM_vec, vec,
      ~ cor(.x, .y,
            method = "spearman",
            use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(subj_id, feature, rho)


cluster_means_rsa <- participant_clusters %>%
  left_join(participant_rsa_weights, by = "subj_id") %>%
  group_by(cluster, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rho = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rho   = sd(rho, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_subjects = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_means_rsa

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

cluster_means_rsa %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = c("sm", "nv", "ang"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = mean_rho, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.7, color = "black") + 
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_rho - se_rho,
        ymax = mean_rho + se_rho),
    position = pd,  # This forces them to align with the bars
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean RSA Feature Weights per Cluster",
    y = "Spearman correlation (RDM)",
    fill = "Feature"
  )

# Positive rho → that feature structures representational similarity
# Near-zero rho → feature not used
# Negative rho → feature systematically anti-aligned with representations
```

```{r}
model_mat <- cbind(sm = v_sm, nv = v_nv, ang = v_ang)
# -------------------------
#  Regression RSA per cluster (on mean RDM)
# -------------------------

cluster_weights <- cluster_rdms %>%
  mutate(
    # Vectorize each cluster’s mean RDM (dependent variable)
    emp_vec = map(mean_RDM, get_rdm_vec),
    
    # Fit multiple regression: empirical dissimilarities ~ sm + nv + ang
    fit = map(emp_vec, ~ {
      # Align to complete cases across models and data
      ok <- complete.cases(.x, model_mat)
      y  <- .x[ok]
      X  <- model_mat[ok, , drop = FALSE]
      lm(y ~ sm + nv + ang, data = as.data.frame(X))
    }),
    
    # Extract coefficients and SEs
    coef_tbl = map(fit, ~ {
      s <- summary(.x)
      tibble(
        feature = rownames(s$coefficients)[-1],  # drop intercept
        beta    = s$coefficients[-1, "Estimate"],
        se      = s$coefficients[-1, "Std. Error"],
        t       = s$coefficients[-1, "t value"],
        p       = s$coefficients[-1, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      )
    })
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, n_subj, coef_tbl) %>%
  unnest(coef_tbl)
```

```{r}
# raw RDM per subject →cluster RDMs → for each cluster, on the individual RDMs run lmer() with random effect for subject. Then display the cluster-level weights.

library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# build predictor table from stim IDs, for each pair
pair_features <- expand_grid(
  low = 1:27,
  high = 1:27
) %>%
  filter(low < high) %>%
  left_join(
    stim_lookup %>%
      rename(low = stim_id,
             sm_low = sm, nv_low = nv, ang_low = ang),
    by = "low"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stim_lookup %>%
      rename(high = stim_id,
             sm_high = sm, nv_high = nv, ang_high = ang),
    by = "high"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sm  = as.numeric(sm_low  != sm_high),
    nv  = as.numeric(nv_low  != nv_high),
    ang = as.numeric(ang_low != ang_high)
  ) %>%
  select(low, high, sm, nv, ang)

# add cluster labels to subject-level RDM data
rsa_lmm_df <- D_subj %>%
  left_join(participant_clusters, by = "subj_id") %>%
  left_join(pair_features, by = c("low", "high")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# check
rsa_lmm_df %>%
  count(cluster, subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subj_id),
    min_pairs = min(n),
    max_pairs = max(n)
  )

# fit one mixed model per cluster, with random effect for subject
cluster_lmm_results <- rsa_lmm_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    fit = map(data, ~ lmer(
      D ~ sm + nv + ang + (1 | subj_id),
      data = .x,
      REML = FALSE
    )),
    coef_tbl = map(fit, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed"))
  ) %>%
  select(cluster, fit, coef_tbl) %>%
  unnest(coef_tbl) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    feature = recode(term,
                     sm = "sm",
                     nv = "nv",
                     ang = "ang"),
    se = std.error,
    beta = estimate
  )

cluster_lmm_results

# bar plot
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

cluster_lmm_results %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = c("sm", "nv", "ang"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = beta, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = beta - se, ymax = beta + se),
    position = pd,
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster-level Feature Weights from Mixed-Effects RSA",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fixed-effect coefficient",
    fill = "Feature"
  )
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# Split-half consistency
# -------------------------
set.seed(4228)
n_iter <- 1000
split_half_corrs <- numeric(n_iter)
split_half_corrs_corrected <- numeric(n_iter)

for (iter in seq_len(n_iter)) {

  # Split participants
  half1 <- sample(subj_ids, n_subj %/% 2)
  half2 <- setdiff(subj_ids, half1)

  # --- Average RDM MATRICES ---
  rdm_half1 <- participant_rdms %>%
    filter(subj_id %in% half1) %>%
    pull(RDM) %>%
    reduce(`+`) / length(half1)

  rdm_half2 <- participant_rdms %>%
    filter(subj_id %in% half2) %>%
    pull(RDM) %>%
    reduce(`+`) / length(half2)

  # --- Vectorize AFTER averaging ---
  vec1 <- get_upper_vec(rdm_half1)
  vec2 <- get_upper_vec(rdm_half2)

  # --- Correlation ---
  r_half <- cor(vec1, vec2, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  split_half_corrs[iter] <- r_half
  split_half_corrs_corrected[iter] <- (2 * r_half) / (1 + r_half)
}

cat("Split-half correlation (mean):", mean(split_half_corrs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Spearman-Brown corrected:", mean(split_half_corrs_corrected, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r}
set.seed(4228)
# Build weight matrix and delta matrix
# weight matrix: 1 = observed, 0 = missing
W <- ifelse(is.na(D_mat), 0, 1)

# replace NA with 0
D_smacof <- D_mat
D_smacof[is.na(D_smacof)] <- 0

# Safety: enforce zero diagonal
diag(D_smacof) <- 0
diag(W) <- 0
```

```{r}
## Compute stress for multiple dimensionalities
# stress is a lack-of-fit measure between:
# The observed dissimilarities and the distances in the low-dimensional space (e.g., 2D)
# “How much information about the dissimilarity structure is lost when I force it into 2 dimensions?”
# If stress is low, then the 2D configuration preserves the rank order of your empirical dissimilarities well.
# If stress is high, 2D is insufficient → try 3D, 4D, etc.
# Stress < 0.05 → excellent fit
# 0.05–0.10 → good
# 0.10–0.20 → fair
# 0.20 → poor

# Try dimensions 1 to 8
dims <- 1:8

stress_tbl <- map_dfr(dims, function(k) {
  fit <- smacof::mds(
    delta = D_smacof,
    weightmat = W,
    type = "ordinal",
    ndim = k
  )
  
  tibble(
    ndim = k,
    stress = fit$stress
  )
})

stress_tbl

# plot the curve
ggplot(stress_tbl, aes(x = ndim, y = stress)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of dimensions",
    y = "Stress",
    title = "Stress vs. dimensionality (ordinal SMACOF)"
  )
```

# MDS on Clusters 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(smacof)

# =========================
# Helper: run SMACOF safely on one RDM
# =========================
run_mds_for_stress <- function(D_cluster, ndim, type = "ordinal") {
  
  # weight matrix: 1 = observed, 0 = missing
  Wc <- ifelse(is.na(D_cluster), 0, 1)
  
  # replace NA with 0 for smacof input
  Dc <- D_cluster
  Dc[is.na(Dc)] <- 0
  
  # safety
  diag(Dc) <- 0
  diag(Wc) <- 0
  
  smacof::mds(
    delta     = Dc,
    weightmat = Wc,
    type      = type,
    ndim      = ndim
  )
}

# =========================
# Choose dimensionality range
# =========================
dims <- 1:8

# =========================
# Compute stress curve per cluster
# cluster_rdms must contain:
#   cluster
#   mean_RDM   (list-column with cluster mean dissimilarity matrices)
#   n_subj
# =========================
cluster_stress_tbl <- cluster_rdms %>%
  select(cluster, n_subj, mean_RDM) %>%
  mutate(
    stress_results = map(mean_RDM, function(Dc) {
      map_dfr(dims, function(k) {
        fit <- run_mds_for_stress(Dc, ndim = k, type = "ordinal")
        
        tibble(
          ndim   = k,
          stress = fit$stress,
          fit    = list(fit)
        )
      })
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-mean_RDM) %>%
  unnest(stress_results)

cluster_stress_tbl


ggplot(cluster_stress_tbl, aes(x = ndim, y = stress)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of dimensions",
    y = "Stress",
    title = "Stress vs. dimensionality for each cluster"
  )
```

# Vector fitting

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)

run_envfit <- function(df, dims, permutations = 999) {
  # ensure no stray 'weights' column is passed
  df <- df %>% select(-matches("^weights$"), everything())

  dim_cols <- paste0("D", seq_len(dims))

  coords <- df %>%
    select(all_of(dim_cols)) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  feats <- df %>%
    select(sm, nv, ang) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  envfit(coords, feats, permutations = permutations, choices = seq_len(dims))
}

envfit_4d_cluster1 <- run_envfit(cluster1_coords_4d, dims = 4)
envfit_4d_cluster2 <- run_envfit(cluster2_coords_4d, dims = 4)

    feature = names(envfit_obj$vectors$r),

    pval    = envfit_obj$vectors$pvals
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      feature = factor(feature, levels = c("sm","nv","ang"))
    )
}
```

```{r}
  arrows <- envfit_obj$vectors$arrows %>%
```

```{r}
conflicts_prefer(plotly::layout)

# =========================
# MDS within RDM-based participant clusters
# (run ordinal SMACOF separately on each cluster's mean RDM)
# =========================

run_cluster_mds <- function(D_cluster, ndim = 3, type = "ordinal") {

  # weight matrix: 1 = observed, 0 = missing
  Wc <- ifelse(is.na(D_cluster), 0, 1)

  # replace NA with 0 for smacof input
  Dc <- D_cluster
  Dc[is.na(Dc)] <- 0

  # safety
  diag(Dc) <- 0
  diag(Wc) <- 0

  smacof::mds(
    delta     = Dc,
    weightmat = Wc,
    type      = type,
    ndim      = ndim
  )
}

# 1) Compute mean RDM per cluster (you already made cluster_rdms above)
# cluster_rdms has: cluster, mean_RDM (list), n_subj

# 2) Run MDS for each cluster (3D and 4D)
cluster_mds <- cluster_rdms %>%
  mutate(
    mds_3d = map(mean_RDM, ~ run_cluster_mds(.x, ndim = 3, type = "ordinal")),
    mds_4d = map(mean_RDM, ~ run_cluster_mds(.x, ndim = 4, type = "ordinal")),
    stress_3d = map_dbl(mds_3d, ~ .x$stress),
    stress_4d = map_dbl(mds_4d, ~ .x$stress)
  )

cluster_mds %>% select(cluster, n_subj, stress_3d, stress_4d)

# 3) Extract coordinates + join stimulus features (reuses your extract_mds_coords)
cluster_coords_3d <- cluster_mds %>%
  transmute(
    cluster, n_subj,
    coords = map(mds_3d, ~ extract_mds_coords(.x, stim_lookup))
  ) %>%
  unnest(coords)

cluster_coords_4d <- cluster_mds %>%
  transmute(
    cluster, n_subj,
    coords = map(mds_4d, ~ extract_mds_coords(.x, stim_lookup))
  ) %>%
  unnest(coords)

# 4) Plot: 3D interactive (plotly) per cluster (colored by sm / nv / ang)
plot_cluster_3d <- function(df, cluster_id, color_col = "sm") {
  dfc <- df %>% filter(cluster == cluster_id)

  plot_ly(data = dfc) %>%
    add_markers(
      x = ~D1, y = ~D2, z = ~D3,
      marker = list(size = 5),
      color = dfc[[color_col]],
      name = "Points"
    ) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste0("Cluster ", cluster_id, " (n=", unique(dfc$n_subj),
                     "): 3D MDS colored by ", color_col)
    )
}
# Example calls (cluster values are factors like "1","2")
plot_cluster_3d(cluster_coords_3d, cluster_id = "1", color_col = "sm")
plot_cluster_3d(cluster_coords_3d, cluster_id = "2", color_col = "sm")

plot_cluster_3d(cluster_coords_3d, cluster_id = "1", color_col = "nv")
plot_cluster_3d(cluster_coords_3d, cluster_id = "2", color_col = "nv")

plot_cluster_3d(cluster_coords_3d, cluster_id = "1", color_col = "ang")
plot_cluster_3d(cluster_coords_3d, cluster_id = "2", color_col = "ang")

# 5) Plot: 4D projections (ggplot) per cluster (reuse your plot_mds_projection)
plot_cluster_4d_projection <- function(df, cluster_id, d1, d2, color_by = NULL, title = "") {
  dfc <- df %>% filter(cluster == cluster_id)
  plot_mds_projection(
    df = dfc,
    d1 = d1, d2 = d2,
    color_by = color_by,
    title = paste0("Cluster ", cluster_id, " (n=", unique(dfc$n_subj), "): ", title)
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)

# =========================
# Helpers (3D only)
# =========================

cor_mds_features <- function(df, ndim = 3) {
  dim_cols <- paste0("D", 1:ndim)

  df %>%
    select(all_of(dim_cols), sm, nv, ang) %>%
    mutate(across(c(sm, nv, ang), as.numeric)) %>%
    cor(use = "complete.obs")
}

make_cor_kable <- function(target_cor, title = "Stimulus Features") {
  target_cor %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    round(3) %>%
    kable(
      col.names = c("Smoothness", "NV", "Angle"),
      align = "c",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      format = "html"
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left",
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
      font_size = 20
    ) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, title = 3))
}

run_envfit_3d <- function(df, permutations = 999) {
  coords <- df %>% select(D1, D2, D3)
  feats  <- df %>% select(sm, nv, ang) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  envfit(coords, feats, permutations = permutations, choices = 1:3)
}

extract_envfit_r2 <- function(envfit_obj, cluster_id) {
  data.frame(
    cluster = cluster_id,
    feature = names(envfit_obj$vectors$r),
    r2      = envfit_obj$vectors$r,      # already r²
    pval    = envfit_obj$vectors$pvals
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      feature = factor(feature, levels = c("sm", "nv", "ang")),
      label   = sprintf("p=%.3f", pval)
    )
}

# =========================
# 1) Per-cluster 3D correlations (D1–D3 vs sm/nv/ang)
# =========================

clusters <- sort(unique(as.character(cluster_coords_3d$cluster)))

cor_tables_3d <- map(clusters, function(cl) {
  dfc <- cluster_coords_3d %>% filter(cluster == cl)

  full_cor <- cor_mds_features(dfc, ndim = 3)
  mds_dims <- paste0("D", 1:3)
  feats    <- c("sm", "nv", "ang")

  target_cor <- full_cor[mds_dims, feats, drop = FALSE]

  list(cluster = cl, target_cor = target_cor)
})

for (obj in cor_tables_3d) {
  cat("\n\n")
  print(
    make_cor_kable(obj$target_cor, title = paste0("Cluster ", obj$cluster, " — Stimulus Features (3D)"))
  )
}

# =========================
# 2) Envfit per cluster (3D) + tidy r² table
# =========================

envfit_3d_by_cluster <- map(clusters, function(cl) {
  dfc <- cluster_coords_3d %>% filter(cluster == cl)
  run_envfit_3d(dfc, permutations = 999)
})
names(envfit_3d_by_cluster) <- clusters

r2_3d_all <- imap_dfr(envfit_3d_by_cluster, ~ extract_envfit_r2(.x, cluster_id = .y))

# inspect table
r2_3d_all

# =========================
# 3) Plot r² bars per cluster (3D)
# =========================
r2_3d_all <- r2_3d_all %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(pval < 0.05, "*", ""))

ggplot(r2_3d_all, aes(x = feature, y = r2, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, y = pmin(r2 + 0.05, 0.98)), size = 6) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, nrow = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Vector Fit Strength by Cluster (3D MDS)",
    x = NULL, y = expression(r^2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Optional: print raw envfit outputs (examples)
# envfit_3d_by_cluster[["1"]]
# envfit_3d_by_cluster[["2"]]

# note: sign is arbitrary (still true per-cluster)
```

```{r}

# =========================
# Envfit vector table helpers
# =========================
extract_envfit_table <- function(envfit_obj) {

  # vector directions
  arrows <- envfit_obj$vectors$arrows %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature")

  # r² values
  r2 <- envfit_obj$vectors$r

  # keep features as rows, dimensions as columns
  arrow_tbl <- arrows %>%
    mutate(
      feature = recode(feature,
        sm  = "Smoothness",
        nv  = "NV",
        ang = "Angle"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(feature, D1, D2, D3)

  # add r² as a column
  arrow_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      R2 = c(r2["sm"], r2["nv"], r2["ang"])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(D1, D2, D3, R2), ~ signif(.x, 2))
    )
}

make_envfit_kable <- function(df, title) {

  df %>%
    kable(
      col.names = c("", "D1", "D2", "D3", "R²"),
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
      booktabs = TRUE,
      format = "html"
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left",
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
      font_size = 20
    ) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, title = 4))
}

envfit_tables <- imap(envfit_3d_by_cluster, function(env, cl) {

  tbl <- extract_envfit_table(env)

  list(
    cluster = cl,
    table = tbl
  )
})

for (obj in envfit_tables) {

  cat("\n\n")

  print(
    make_envfit_kable(
      obj$table,
      paste0("Cluster ", obj$cluster)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13)
  )

p2 <- ggplot(filter(r2_4d_all, cluster == "2"),
             aes(x = feature, y = r2, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.58, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, y = r2 + 0.03), size = 7) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster 2, 4D MDS",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(r^2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.02),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13)
  )

p1 + p2
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Export MDS coordinates + stimulus info for 3D website
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

# --------------------------------------------------
# USER SETTINGS: edit these in each analysis file
# --------------------------------------------------
experiment_id <- "Exp1"         # "Exp1" or "Exp2"
condition_id  <- "curvature"    # "curvature" or "noInstr"

# Assumes cluster_coords_3d already exists
# and includes:
#   Exp1: cluster, D1, D2, D3, nv, ang, sm
#   Exp2: cluster, D1, D2, D3, nv, rng, sm

# --------------------------------------------------
# Basic checks
# --------------------------------------------------
required_common <- c("cluster", "D1", "D2", "D3", "nv", "sm")
missing_common <- setdiff(required_common, names(cluster_coords_3d))

if (length(missing_common) > 0) {
  stop("cluster_coords_3d is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_common, collapse = ", "))
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Build JSON data depending on experiment
# --------------------------------------------------
if (experiment_id == "Exp1") {

  required_exp1 <- c("ang")
  missing_exp1 <- setdiff(required_exp1, names(cluster_coords_3d))

  if (length(missing_exp1) > 0) {
    stop("For Exp1, cluster_coords_3d must contain: ",
         paste(missing_exp1, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Map analysis smoothness coding to image filename coding
  # analysis: sm = 0,1,2
  # image files: s0.0, s0.8, s1.4
  sm_to_file <- c("0" = "0.0",
                  "1" = "0.8",
                  "2" = "1.4")

  mds_web_data <- cluster_coords_3d %>%
    mutate(
      experiment  = experiment_id,
      condition   = condition_id,
      stimulus_id = paste0("nv", nv, "_ang", ang, "_sm", sm),

      s_file = unname(sm_to_file[as.character(sm)]),

      img_file = paste0(
        "stim_nv", nv,
        "_ang", ang,
        "_s", s_file,
        "_rot+000.png"
      ),

      # relative to HTML file location inside this condition folder
      img_path = file.path("..", "figures", "stimuli", img_file),

      rng = NA
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      stimulus_id,
      D1, D2, D3,
      nv, ang, sm, rng,
      img_file,
      img_path
    )

} else if (experiment_id == "Exp2") {

  required_exp2 <- c("rng")
  missing_exp2 <- setdiff(required_exp2, names(cluster_coords_3d))

  if (length(missing_exp2) > 0) {
    stop("For Exp2, cluster_coords_3d must contain: ",
         paste(missing_exp2, collapse = ", "))
  }

  mds_web_data <- cluster_coords_3d %>%
    mutate(
      experiment  = experiment_id,
      condition   = condition_id,
      stimulus_id = paste0("nv", nv, "_rng", rng, "_sm", sm),

      # image names use curv0/1/2 even though analysis uses sm
      img_file = paste0(
        "circle_rng", rng,
        "_N", nv,
        "_curv", sm,
        "_seed10.png"
      ),

      # relative to HTML file location inside this condition folder
      img_path = file.path("..", "figures2", "images", img_file),

      ang = NA
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      stimulus_id,
      D1, D2, D3,
      nv, ang, rng, sm,
      img_file,
      img_path
    )

} else {
  stop("experiment_id must be either 'Exp1' or 'Exp2'")
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Make output folder
# --------------------------------------------------
dir.create("mds_site", showWarnings = FALSE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Write JSON
# --------------------------------------------------
write_json(
  mds_web_data,
  path = file.path("mds_site", "mds_data.json"),
  pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)

cat("Saved JSON to:", file.path("mds_site", "mds_data.json"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Export 3D envfit vectors for website
# =========================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tibble)
library(vegan)

# --------------------------------------------------
# USER SETTINGS: edit these in each analysis file
# --------------------------------------------------
experiment_id <- "Exp1"      # "Exp1" or "Exp2"
condition_id  <- "curvature"   # "curvature" or "noInstr"

# Assumes cluster_coords_3d already exists and includes:
#   common: cluster, D1, D2, D3, nv, sm
#   Exp1: ang
#   Exp2: rng

# --------------------------------------------------
# Basic checks
# --------------------------------------------------
required_common <- c("cluster", "D1", "D2", "D3", "nv", "sm")
missing_common <- setdiff(required_common, names(cluster_coords_3d))

if (length(missing_common) > 0) {
  stop(
    "cluster_coords_3d is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_common, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (experiment_id == "Exp1") {
  feature_var <- "ang"
} else if (experiment_id == "Exp2") {
  feature_var <- "rng"
} else {
  stop("experiment_id must be either 'Exp1' or 'Exp2'")
}

if (!(feature_var %in% names(cluster_coords_3d))) {
  stop(
    "For ", experiment_id, ", cluster_coords_3d must contain column: ", feature_var
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Envfit helper
# --------------------------------------------------
run_envfit_3d <- function(df, feature_var, permutations = 999) {
  coords <- df %>%
    select(D1, D2, D3)

  feats <- df %>%
    select(sm, nv, all_of(feature_var)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

  envfit(coords, feats, permutations = permutations, choices = 1:3)
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Extract envfit results into tidy table
# --------------------------------------------------
extract_envfit_vectors <- function(envfit_obj, cluster_id, experiment_id, condition_id) {

  arrows <- envfit_obj$vectors$arrows %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature")

  r2_vals <- envfit_obj$vectors$r
  p_vals  <- envfit_obj$vectors$pvals

  arrows %>%
    mutate(
      experiment = experiment_id,
      condition  = condition_id,
      cluster    = as.character(cluster_id),
      r2         = unname(r2_vals[feature]),
      pval       = unname(p_vals[feature])
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      feature,
      D1, D2, D3,
      r2,
      pval
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      feature_label = case_when(
        feature == "sm"  ~ "Smoothness",
        feature == "nv"  ~ "NV",
        feature == "rng" ~ "Range",
        feature == "ang" ~ "Angle",
        TRUE             ~ feature
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      experiment,
      condition,
      cluster,
      feature,
      feature_label,
      D1, D2, D3,
      r2,
      pval
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Run envfit per cluster
# --------------------------------------------------
clusters <- sort(unique(as.character(cluster_coords_3d$cluster)))

envfit_3d_by_cluster <- map(clusters, function(cl) {
  dfc <- cluster_coords_3d %>% filter(cluster == cl)
  run_envfit_3d(dfc, feature_var = feature_var, permutations = 999)
})
names(envfit_3d_by_cluster) <- clusters

# --------------------------------------------------
# Combine into one export table
# --------------------------------------------------
vectorfit_web_data <- imap_dfr(envfit_3d_by_cluster, function(env, cl) {
  extract_envfit_vectors(
    envfit_obj     = env,
    cluster_id     = cl,
    experiment_id  = experiment_id,
    condition_id   = condition_id
  )
})

# Optional: inspect
print(vectorfit_web_data)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Make output folder
# --------------------------------------------------
dir.create("mds_site", showWarnings = FALSE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Write JSON
# --------------------------------------------------
write_json(
  vectorfit_web_data,
  path = file.path("mds_site", "vector_fits.json"),
  pretty = TRUE,
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)

cat("Saved JSON to:", file.path("mds_site", "vector_fits.json"), "\n")
```
